author: smuzaffar
body:
The change fixes the build warnings  like [a]. The unused variables were used in the commented out code, so this PR also proposes to remove the commented out code too. 

[a]

    72 |         Vector5d par2;
      |                  ^~~~
  [src/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp:75](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-12-2300/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp#L75):18: warning: unused variable 'cov2' [-Wunused-variable]
    75 |         Matrix5d cov2;
      |                  ^~~~
src/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp: In function 'int main()':
  [src/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp:72](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-12-2300/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp#L72):18: warning: unused variable 'par2' [-Wunused-variable]
    72 |         Vector5d par2;
      |                  ^~~~
  [src/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp:75](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-12-2300/RecoTracker/PixelTrackFitting/test/testEigenJacobian.cpp#L75):18: warning: unused variable 'cov2' [-Wunused-variable]

title: testEigenJacobian: Fix build warning by removing unused variables and commented out code
